QuestInfo.name: [Snowdrift Lodge] Let's Roll the Dice (All 30 of Us)
QuestInfo.0: A 30-Player Dice Game is held regularly at the Snowdrift Lodge.\r\nIt's a very simple game where each player rolls 2 dice, and the one with the highest number wins. There are a total of 5 rounds per game and prizes are given to the top 3 players from each round. But remember, when the resort closes, so does the dice game!
